breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. The original prompt incorrectly asked for a variable-cell relaxation (`vc-relax`) while also stating to keep the lattice vectors fixed. The agent repeated this error by including the instruction "Keep the lattice vectors fixed during the ionic relaxation and relax only the atomic positions," which contradicts the primary task of a `vc-relax` calculation. The ground truth correctly removes this contradictory statement.
